return_text:
# Local-model workloads beyond memory and RAG (2026-09-24)

Grades: I independent, A academic, S maker, C competitor, P popularity. M = measured elsewhere; E = estimated from this Mac's measured Qwen3.8-27B numbers.

|Workload · why local|Best · runner-up|Evidence|Throughput here|Acceptance test|Verdict|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|**1. Point-in-time text features** for backtests (8-Ks, news). Local: cloud models cannot be pinned to a cutoff; dated weights are the clean control.|[PIT-4B-FT](https://huggingface.co/Diamegs) dated checkpoints to 2024-12, Apache-2.0 · [ChronoGPT/ChronoBERT](https://huggingface.co/manelalab) v1, 1.55B, yearly cutoffs, MIT|A [Gao et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23847) 2026-06-12: lookahead propensity positive in-sample, ~0 after cutoff. A [Zhang & Stadie](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02985) 2026-08-04: leakage concentrates on surprising outcomes; needs clean controls. A [He et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.21206) 2025-07-06: bias modest in one news test. A/S [Kelly et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11889) 2026-07-17: PiT news Sharpe 1.0–1.5|E ~1–2K tok/s prefill; embeddings only|Frozen EdgarTools 8-Ks 2015–2024 with acceptance times; prior-month checkpoint embeddings → rolling ridge on next-day abnormal return; baselines Loughran-McDonald tone and Qwen3.8-27B; OOS rank-IC, net Sharpe, HAC t>2|**Trial first**: cleanest route to LLM text signals in backtests|
|**2. Catalyst tagging/extraction** (event, offering, FDA, contract terms) from 8-Ks and releases; ex-post labels for +200% movers, never backtest signals. Local: backfill volume, pinned labels.|[Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B) (installed, 2026-08-14, Apache-2.0) with JSON schema · [GLiNER2](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2) (2025) CPU encoder as distilled student|S [Massive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08346) 2026-07-09: 119 event types, 601,088 tags on 292,984 8-Ks; 0.927 precision at score ≥4 (LLM-judged). A [GLiNER2](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-demos.10/) EMNLP 2025. Local accuracy: unknown|E 15–26 s per 3–5K-token filing: ~260 daily 8-Ks ≈1–2 h; 293K backfill ≈50–90 days (use 9B or student)|1,000 stratified 2025–26 8-Ks from Massive + 300 hand-checked; baselines Opus 5.5 labels and Massive tags; macro-F1, field exact match, filings/hour|**Trial**; adopt for backfill if F1 ≥0.9× Opus|
|**3. Earnings-call ASR and diarization** (also FDA panels, conferences). Local: season-peak volume at zero marginal cost; offline.|[Cohere Transcribe 03-2026](https://huggingface.co/CohereLabs/cohere-transcribe-03-2026) (2B, Apache-2.0, mlx-audio) · [Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3) (CC-BY-4.0, 2025-08)|I [Open ASR long-form](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hf-audio/leaderboard_longform) 2026-09-24: Earnings-21/22 WER Cohere 8.7/12.66, Whisper-v3-turbo 9.84/13.1, Parakeet 9.96/14.58; best proprietary 6.48/9.99. [Short-form](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hf-audio/open-asr-leaderboard-results) Earnings22: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 5.84, Parakeet 5.85|M (S, [FluidAudio](https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio/blob/main/Documentation/Benchmarks.md), read 2026-09-24): Parakeet 155.6× real time on M4 Pro (LibriSpeech; 1-h call ≈23 s); diarization 323× on M5 Pro. Cohere: unknown|Earnings-21 (44 calls, entity tags) + Earnings-22 (119 h), full calls; baseline Whisper-large-v3-turbo; WER, entity WER, RTFx, DER|**Trial** (one day): Cohere if ≥50× real time here, else Parakeet; skip if vendor transcripts suffice|
|**4. Image-only exhibits** (slide decks), IR PDFs, legacy scans. Local: bulk backfill at zero marginal cost.|[TeleOCR](https://huggingface.co/StarDoc-AI/TeleOCR) (1.2B, Apache-2.0, 2026-08-17) · [PaddleOCR-VL-1.6](https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.6) (0.9B, Apache-2.0, 2026-05-28; official MLX-VLM Mac path)|I [OmniDocBench v1.6](https://github.com/opendatalab/OmniDocBench) updated 2026-09-11: 96.91 vs 96.34. A [EDGAR-OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.18192) 2026-06: 300 SEC tables, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 75.8% vs Mistral OCR 3 75.3% adjusted recall|Unknown; E ~5–15 s/page (decode-bound)|300 10-Q statement tables rendered to PNG, scored against XBRL facts, + 100 hand-labeled slides; baseline Qwen3.8-27B vision; numeric-cell exact match (pass ≥99%), TEDS, s/page|**Trial**, narrow: XBRL and HTML already cover most filings deterministically|
|**5. Time-series foundation models** for volatility and volume features. Local: small, CPU-capable, deterministic.|[Chronos-2](https://github.com/amazon-science/chronos-forecasting) (120M, Apache-2.0, 2025-10-20) · [TTM r2.1](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-timeseries-ttm-r2) (~1M, Apache-2.0). TimesFM-3 (2026-08-31) scores higher; weights non-commercial, non-production|S [fev-bench](https://huggingface.co/spaces/autogluon/fev-bench) (run by Chronos's maker) 2026-09-24: skill Chronos-2 35.5, TimesFM-3 37.4 (mirror). C [IBM](https://huggingface.co/blog/ibm-research/ibm-releases-sota-granite-time-series) 2026-09-09: TimesFM-3 first on zero-shot GIFT-Eval CRPS. A [Brini](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05291) 2026-07-06: of nine zero-shot TSFMs only TTM beats Log-HAR on realized volatility (QLIKE ratio 0.982–0.987)|M (S): Chronos-2 >300 series/s on A10G; Mac unknown; TTM runs on CPU|5-minute realized variance, 500 stocks, rolling origin after each model's release; baseline Log-HAR; QLIKE, Diebold-Mariano p<0.05|**Trial**, low priority; skip for returns|
|**6. Tool-output injection screening** in agent hooks. Local: per-call latency and cost; outputs may hold code or secrets.|[PIGuard](https://github.com/leolee99/PIGuard) (184M, MIT, ACL 2025) · [Prompt Guard 2 86M](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-Prompt-Guard-2-86M) (2025-04)|A [PIArena](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.1533/) ACL 2026: PIGuard keeps utility (72% vs 74%) but allows over 22% attack success; adaptive attacks unsolved. A [PIDS-Bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15017) 2026-09-14: an F1-0.98 detector misflags about a third of external benign inputs|M (S): Prompt Guard 2 92 ms per 512 tokens on A100; Mac unknown|2,000 redacted benign outputs from own sessions + PIArena injections; baseline no detector; TPR at FPR ≤1%, p95 latency|**Trial**, flag-only; never a security boundary|

**Not worth running locally**

- Primary agent loop (coding, review, planning, synthesis): on AA v4.3.2 Qwen3.8-27B scores 34 vs Opus 5.5 58 and GPT-6 Astra 53 ([AA](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/qwen3-8-27b), 2026-09-24; an [Aug-17 report](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/17/qwen-38-27b-scores-52/) said 52, unresolved); its index run emitted 200M tokens, ≈89 days at 26 tok/s.
- Return forecasting with TSFMs: zero-shot OOS R² −1.37% (Chronos), −2.80% (TimesFM) vs −0.03% (CatBoost) on daily excess returns ([Rahimikia et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18578), 2025-11-23, A).
- Tabular foundation models for mover prediction: trees and deep nets still win on temporal, non-IID, large data ([BeyondArena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30410), 2026-06-29, A); TabPFN-3 weights are non-commercial.
- Text-to-SQL, filing Q&A and LLM judging: low volume, no privacy driver, and the capability gap above. Numeric, risk and order state stay deterministic.

**Notes**

- Runtimes: row 2 in Ollama; ASR via FluidAudio or mlx-audio; OCR via MLX-VLM; TSFMs via PyTorch (TimesFM-3 ships MLX). PIT-4B needs trust_remote_code: pin a revision and review the code first.
- Persist outputs with model digests in DuckDB.
- Conflicts: OmniDocBench's maintainer builds MinerU; NVIDIA, Mistral and OpenAI co-author Open ASR; FluidAudio numbers are the vendor's.
- If generic TSFMs fail, try finance-pretrained [Kronos](https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos) (AAAI 2026, MIT; S).
- Unknown: M5 Pro speeds for OCR, PiT, TSFMs and Cohere; Massive data terms; EDGAR-OCR data release.
